speeches.speaker: Julia Gillard
speeches.brief: Moved the Medicare Levy Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill, arguing that a higher Medicare levy would provide a secure, long-term funding stream for DisabilityCare Australia and help ensure people with significant, permanent disability receive care and support regardless of where they live.

speeches.speaker: Bill Shorten
speeches.brief: Moved the Superannuation (Excess Non-Concessional Contributions Tax) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill, proposing that the tax rate on excess non-concessional contributions rise from 46.5 per cent to 47 per cent from 1 July 2014, with revenue supporting DisabilityCare Australia.

speeches.speaker: Bill Shorten
speeches.brief: Moved the Superannuation (Excess Untaxed Roll-Over Amounts Tax) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill, proposing that the tax rate on excess untaxed roll-over amounts rise from 46.5 per cent to 47 per cent from 1 July 2014 to reflect the Medicare levy increase.

speeches.speaker: David Bradbury
speeches.brief: Moved the Income Tax (TFN Withholding Tax (ESS)) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill, proposing that withholding tax on discounted employee shares or rights rise from 46.5 per cent to 47 per cent from 1 July 2014, with revenue supporting DisabilityCare Australia.

speeches.speaker: David Bradbury
speeches.brief: Moved the Income Tax Rates Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill, explaining that a Medicare levy component applying where superannuation funds or retirement savings account providers lack a tax file number would increase from 1 July 2014 to reflect the higher levy.

speeches.speaker: David Bradbury
speeches.brief: Moved the Taxation (Trustee Beneficiary Non-Disclosure Tax) (No. 1) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill, proposing that the trustee beneficiary non-disclosure tax rate rise from 46.5 per cent to 47 per cent from 1 July 2014 to reflect the Medicare levy increase.

speeches.speaker: David Bradbury
speeches.brief: Introduced consequential tax amendments to raise the trustee beneficiary non-disclosure tax rate from 46.5 to 47 per cent from 1 July 2014, matching the increase in the Medicare levy from 1.5 to 2 per cent to fund DisabilityCare Australia.

speeches.speaker: David Bradbury
speeches.brief: Proposed matching consequential amendments raising the First Home Saver Accounts misuse tax rate from 46.5 to 47 per cent from 1 July 2014, aligning it with the Medicare levy increase from 1.5 to two per cent that funds DisabilityCare Australia.

speeches.speaker: Mark Butler
speeches.brief: Moved to suspend standing orders so debate on the Medicare Levy Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill 2013, 11 related bills, and the National Disability Insurance Scheme Legislation Amendment Bill 2013 could resume at a later hour.

speeches.speaker: Anne McEwen
speeches.brief: The Selection of Bills Committee report recommended referring the Australian Jobs Bill 2013, Export Market Development Grants Amendment Bill 2013, Private Health Insurance Legislation Amendment (Base Premium) Bill 2013, and Public Governance, Performance and Accountability Bill 2013 to specific committees for inquiry by June 2013, and recommended not referring several other bills including the DisabilityCare Australia Fund Bill 2013 and related tax bills; the report was adopted.

speeches.speaker: Jacinta Collins
speeches.brief: Moved to suspend standing orders so that 14 bills related to DisabilityCare Australia (the National Disability Insurance Scheme) could be considered during the current sitting period; the motion was agreed to.
